mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.customer_id AS customerId, CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS completed, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount FROM order_refund r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE

SELECT r.id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, rt.return_no AS returnNo, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.completed_at AS completedAt FROM order_refund r JOIN customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN order_return rt ON rt.id = r.return_id AND rt.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_payment p ON p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.id IS NULL
AND FALSE
AND FALSE
AND c.seller_id IN #{sellerId}
AND (r.refund_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(rt.return_no, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(o.order_no, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT r.id FROM payment_refund r WHERE r.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND r.source_id = #{orderRefundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
